title: Why Not Hinduism?
summary: Placeholder framing comparing Christianity's and Hinduism's accounts of God and the world. Replace with your own writing.

argument.conclusion: Christianity offers a more coherent account of God, the world, and personal identity than Hinduism does.

premises.text: Hinduism's pantheistic and karmic framework struggles to ground objective moral responsibility.
Christianity's claim of a single historical incarnation fits the evidence better than a cycle of reincarnation with no historical anchor.

objections.text: Isn't it arrogant to say one religious tradition is simply correct and others aren't?
